items.title: Creator of Virtual Worlds
items.description: On a creative path to spark new worlds into existence using art, design and code.
items.body: Exploring who I am through the process of creation. Using every available technology to shape reality of these alternate universes. Reflecting on ways to improve the world in our base reality from what I discover. Bring together all agents of consciousness in human form or another to experience new worlds.
